description: This file generates demo notes data for the application, primarily used for previewing the UI when a feature flag is enabled. It creates sample notes with titles, content, tags, priority, color, and timestamps, and provides a function to load this demo data conditionally.

methods.name: makeDemoNotes()
methods.description: Generates an array of sample note objects with predefined content for demonstration purposes.

methods.name: loadDemoDataIfEnabled(flags)
methods.description: Exports demo notes if the feature flag for demo data is enabled; otherwise, returns null.
